  1. Verify L1 NCP SNCP service deletion using Intent Resource ID

    Description: All the FREs, TPEs and expectation should be deleted if user fetches through intent resource id.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/nsi/api/{NSI_VER}/fres?freExpectations.serviceIntent.id={INTENT_RSC_ID}&include=tpes, expectations, frePlanned, freDiscovered*

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/nsi/api/v6/fres?freExpectations.serviceIntent.id=5f1657e0-0635-48b5-a467-68c0a3f40e5d&include=tpes, expectations, frePlanned, freDiscovered*

    Request parameter:

    • INTENT_RSC_ID - Intent resource id will be received from step 2

    • NSI_VER - v6

Sample response:

  {
    "links": {},
    "data": []
  }

Response describe about no FREs, TPEs, expectation should be found since all has been deleted.

Create (or delete) L0 DTLSETs

This section describes an API to create L0 planned or deployed DTLSETs.

Notes

  • Usage of this functionality requires an Navigator MC Plus license.

  • Up to 20 DTLs can be specified in the DTLSET.

  • The first DTL is created as the 'home' DTL; the subsequent DTLs are created as the 'protection DTLs'.

Limitations

  • Creating DTLSETs with Cascaded DTLs (i.e. to utilize regens) is not yet supported.

Steps to create a DTLSET

  1. Retrieve an available PreProvisionServiceContainer resource

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?resourceTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.PreProvisionServiceContainer

Extract the id of any of the returned responses. This will be the RESOURCE_ID.

Sample:

{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "5f33fa93-96a6-4271-ba3d-11de6ffec9ce",
      "label": "Resource for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.PreProvisionServiceContainer",
      "resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.PreProvisionServiceContainer",
      "productId": "5f33fa4e-ba1e-4f2e-bc9c-6f3cf645fc76",
      "tenantId": "9c36d2e8-3702-410f-9d80-1cc530039dd2",
      "shared": false,
      "subDomainId": "7fd5144c-552f-39a3-9464-08d3b9cfb251",
      "properties": {},
      "discovered": false,
      "differences": [],
      "desiredOrchState": "active",
      "orchState": "active",
      "reason": "",
      "tags": {},
      "providerData": {
        "templateResources": {}
      },
      "updatedAt": "2020-08-12T14:20:03.909Z",
      "createdAt": "2020-08-12T14:20:03.803Z",
      "revision": 13194139535991,
      "autoClean": false,
      "updateState": "unset",
      "updateReason": "",
      "updateCount": 0
    },
    ...
  ]
}

  1. Create a DTLSET

POST {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RESOURCE_ID}/operations

with sample payload:

{
  "interface": "createDtlSet",
  "inputs": {
    "deploymentMode": "PLANNED",
    "dtlSetData": {
      "label": "dtlSetLabel",
      "origNodeName": "NE3",
      "termNodeName": "NE4",
      "dtls": [
        {
          "label": "home",
          "dtlOsrpData": [
            {
              "osrpNodeName": "NE3",
              "osrpLinkId": "122"
            }
          ],
          "txInfo": [
            {
              "dropPort": "ADJ-1-6-5",
              "frequency": "193.7",
              "linkOptimizationMode": "LNKSTDMODE"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "label": "protection1",
          "dtlOsrpData": [
            {
              "osrpNodeName": "NE3",
              "osrpLinkId": "102"
            },
            {
              "osrpNodeName": "NE1",
              "osrpLinkId": "122"
            }
          ],
          "txInfo": [
            {
              "dropPort": "ADJ-1-6-5",
              "linkOptimizationMode": "LNKSTDMODE"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

Attribute notes:

Key Value

deploymentMode

Options are "PLANNED" (to be deployed later as part of service provisioning) or "NOW" (deploy to network at this time).

origNodeName,termNodeName,osrpNodeName

These are the L0 OSRP node names.

txInfo

This is a list of ADJ TX attributes for the DTL. Possible attributes specified are: dropPort (required), transMode, frequency, minDispersion,maxDispersion,lowFrequencyGuardBand,highFrequencyGuardBand,expectedRestorationTime,linkOptimizationMode

Steps to delete a DTLSET

  1. Retrieve an available PreProvisionServiceContainer resource

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?resourceTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.PreProvisionServiceContainer

Extract the id of any of the returned responses. This will be the RESOURCE_ID.

Sample:

{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "5f33fa93-96a6-4271-ba3d-11de6ffec9ce",
      "label": "Resource for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.PreProvisionServiceContainer",

  1. Delete the DTLSET

POST {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RESOURCE_ID}/operations

with sample payload:

{
  "interface": "deleteDtlSet",
  "inputs": {
    "dtlSetIds": [
      "08520b1c-9fc0-471e-8b7f-819eb08934a38d5057e2-65dc-473a-9586-19efcaf57029",
      "ab73d7ae-4af1-4568-bf35-598444b2cfa628bec709-e1f3-4774-94b4-80951408d9bb"
    ]
  }
}

Attribute notes:

Key Value

dtlSetIds

  1. Get delete DTLSET operation id given an Navigator MC FRE id

In the event a client has only the Navigator MC Fre id, a list of deletion operation Ids can be retrieved

POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RESOURCE_ID}/operations

with sample payload:

{
  "interface": "retrieveResourceOperation",
  "inputs": {
    "operationInterface":"deleteDtlSet",
    "freId": "08520b1c-9fc0-471e-8b7f-819eb08934a38d5057e2-65dc-473a-9586-19efcaf57029"
  }
}

Sample response:

{
  "id": "5f46c069-4dd9-433c-a78a-62d2e725ec9f",
  "resourceId": "5f46b2a7-6e45-4ee7-babd-7e9ccc210834",
  "interface": "retrieveResourceOperation",
  "inputs": {
    "operationInterface": "deleteDtlSet",
    "freId": "08520b1c-9fc0-471e-8b7f-819eb08934a38d5057e2-65dc-473a-9586-19efcaf57029"
  },
  "outputs": {},

  "reason": "",

Extract the id from this response; this is the OPERATION_RTRV_ID

GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RESOURCE_ID}/operations/{OPERATION_RTRV_ID}

Sample response:

{

These results show all deletion operations involving the given Navigator MC FRE Id. From the outputs.operation values, clients will likely be more interested in the last operation (this can be inferred from the createdAt attribute). The operationId value can then be subsequently used to fetch the operation details as described in step 3 immediately above

Edit the DTLSET of a L0 SNC(G)

This section describes an API to edit the DTLSET of a deployed L0 SNC(G).

Notes

  • Usage of this functionality requires an Navigator MC Plus license.

  • Changing the path of the home route is not supported at this time. Only the protection paths may be modified.

Requirements

  • The SNC(G) photonic service must be in Deployed state. If the SNC(G) photonic service is in "discovered" state, it can become deployed using the "promotion" API.

  • The DTLSET that the SNC(G) will be switched to must not be currently used by any other service.

Steps to change a discovered SNC(G) photonic service to Deployed state The following steps are used to change a discovered SNC(G) photonic service from "Discovered" to "Deployed" state.

Note: If the SNC(G) photonic service is already in a Deployed state, skip these steps.

  1. Get an available ServicePromotionContainerResource.

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?exactTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ServicePromotionContainer

Extract the id of any of the returned responses. This will be the SERVICE_PROMOTION_RESOURCE.

  1. Find the FRE ID of the "Discovered" SNC(G) photonic service.

An example of how to find the FRE ID is to open the details of the corresponding "Photonic" service in the Optical Services list of the Navigator MC UI. The URL of the details page will provide the FRE ID:

https://{NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/ui/#/transport-services/<FRE ID>

  1. Request promotion of service to Deployed state.

POST {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{SERVICE_PROMOTION_RESOURCE}/operations

with sample payload:

{
  "interface": "promoteService",
  "inputs": {
    "service": {
      "freId": "8230120013569567957"
    }
  }
}

Attribute notes:

Key Value

freId

The FRE ID of the SNC(G) photonic service obtained in step 2.

Sample response:

{
  "id": "5f34002c-c4fe-489a-9c89-0675f73010ac",
  "resourceId": "5f33fa50-e64a-4dc8-b408-246ac9b57c8f",
  "interface": "promoteService",
  "inputs": {
    "service": {
      "freId": "8230120013569567957"
    }
  },
  "outputs": {},
  "state": "requested",
  "reason": "",
  "progress": [],
  "providerData": {},
  "createdAt": "2020-08-12T14:43:56.412Z",
  "updatedAt": "2020-08-12T14:43:56.412Z",
  "revision": 13194139536186,
  "resourceStateConstraints": {},
  "executionGroup": "lifecycle"
}

Extract the id value of the response. This will be the SERVICE_PROMOTION_OPERATION_ID.

  1. Get service promotion result.

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{SERVICE_PROMOTION_RESOURCE}/operations/{SERVICE_PROMOTION_OPERATION_ID}

Sample response:

  "id": "5f34002c-c4fe-489a-9c89-0675f73010ac",

Steps to edit the DTLSET of an MR-SNC

  1. Find the L0ServiceIntentMRFacade id for the deployed service you wish to edit.

To find the market facade id for a photonic or SNC service, utilize the following steps:

a) First, find the service intent for the service using the FRE_ID of the service.

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/nsi/api/fres/{FRE_ID}?include=expectations

From the result, in the top-level entity, find the freExpectations relationship. Extract the id. Find the corresponding entity in the "included" list with the id. In the included entity, find the serviceIntent relationship. The id in this relationship is the SERVICE_INTENT_ID.

Sample expectation snippet:

[
  {
    "data": {
      "id": "-9059378640956306947::58083c09-0544-41d2-8f38-7de501e36357",
      "type": "freExpectations",
      "attributes": {},
      "relationships": {
        "serviceIntent": {
          "data": {
            "type": "serviceIntents",
            "id": "58083c09-0544-41d2-8f38-7de501e36357"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
]

b) Query the facade relationships to find the market facade id associated with the service intent id.

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/relationships?q=targetId%{SERVICE_INTENT_ID}

Set the SERVICE_INTENT_ID in the corresponding location in the URL above. Don’t include the braces.

In the resulting response, the "targetId" will match the SERVICE_INTENT_ID. The corresponding "sourceId" value is the L0_MRSNC_FACADE_ID.

Sample response:

{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "5f3adbc4-a679-4c62-8902-392d6dab8b67",
      "relationshipTypeId": "ifd.v6.relationshipTypes.FcHasFacade",
      "properties": {},
      "sourceId": "5f3adbc3-8c4c-4d20-b9da-5525823b9d31",
      "requirementName": "facades",
      "targetId": "5f3adbc4-812b-4775-89b7-037c12c0559f",
      "capabilityName": "l0ServiceIntentMRFacadeCapability",
      "orchState": "active",
      "reason": "",
      "providerData": {}
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "offset": 1,
  "limit": 1000
}

Note: To view the market facade given the id,

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/{ID}

  1. Request the edit

POST {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{L0_MRSNC_FACADE_ID}/operations

with sample payload:

{
    "interface": "modify",
    "inputs": {
        "differences": [
            {
                "op": "replace",
                "path": "/properties/primaryPathConstraints/dtlSetName",
                "value": "8230120013569567957"
            }
        ],
        "options": {
            "deleteUnusedEntities": true
        }
    }
}

Attribute notes:

Key Value

op

Utilize "add" if dtlSetName is not found in L0ServiceIntentMRFacade entity; use "replace" if dtlSetName found in L0ServiceIntentMRFacade entity.

value

FRE id of the DTLSET

options

Optional attributes available for the API. This section is optional.

'deleteUnusedEntities' is an option used to indicate if the old (unused) DTLSET should be deleted (true) or not deleted (false). If the option is not indicated, then the API will use the GCS property 'sncg_edit_delete_unused_entities' which defaults to True.

Setting the GCS property that defines how old (unused) DTLSET is handled in the API

Note: To overrive the GCS property value, specify the 'deleteUnusedEntities' attribute in the options section of the input body.

a) Go to System → Configuration section of the Navigator MC UI.

b) Create a new configuration setting with the following parameters:

Name: SNCG edit unused entities behavior
Key: sncg_edit_delete_unused_entities
Application: bpo-ifd
Value: false | true
Description: Specifies if unused entities should be deleted

Visualisation/Troubleshooting of Transport client services

This section describes visualisation of Transport client services

Requirements

  • For Transport client services to be discovered the tribport of the ctps across the OTUk/ODUk FREAp should match.

L1 Non-Controlplane Service Edit Label

Use this procedure to perform edit label operation on deployed or discovered Switched OTN l1 NCP services.

Prerequisites

Before you begin:

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the following TOSCA definitions:

    • L1NCPServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacadeTemplate.tosca

Steps

  1. Retrieve Managed Services Container ID

  1. Performed L1 Non-Controlplane Service Edit Label Operation

    Description: Performed L1 Non-Controlplane service edit label operation.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{MSC_ID}/operations

    Request Body
{
  "inputs": {
    "service": {
      "freId": "-7490502324602302552",
      "managedOperation": "Edit",
      "managedSubOperation": "Add",
      "label": "L1_NCP_SERVICE_NEW_LABEL"
    }
  },
  "interface": "manageService"
}

Add Protection On L1 NCP Unprotected Transport Client Service

Below API describes about add protection on an L1 NCP unprotected service. In this API 'preserve route' option is being used for adding the protection on an unprotected service. Preserve route option preserves the existing unprotected service route as work leg and allow user to add new constraints for protect leg.

Prerequisites

  • User should have L1 NCP unprotected transport client service Provisioned/Discovered before performing 'Add protection' operation from Navigator MC GUI. Below screen-shot displays 'Add protection' button on Navigator MC GUI for L1 NCP unprotected service.

Steps

  1. Retrieve product id from Navigator MC Server for L1 NCP protected service

    Description: Different service types are mapped to different products in Navigator MC. This step is to retrieve the product id for a service (NCP protected) which user wants to create. In this case, it is L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/products

    Sample response:

      {

        }
      }
    ],
    "total": 3,
    "offset": 0,
    "limit": 1000
  }

  1. Create facade for L1 NCP Protected service

    Description: The facade encapsulates all request parameters provided by user. Whenever an external client connects to Navigator MC Server, it needs to send in all request parameter in facade used for that service. In this case, it is L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

    Request Parameters:

    Parameter Value

    product ID

    Retrieved from step 1

    Label or name

    <name of the SNCP>

    interactive_mode

    True/False

    Layer rate

    <layer rate>

    Ex: DSR_10GE, OC192, ODU0, ODU2 etc

    endpoint A

    • <Network Element> name A end

    • Shelf A end

    • Slot A end

    • Port A end

    • ChannelizedEndPointInfo A-End (for OTN)

      • tribPort

      • payloadType

      • layerRate

      • tribSlot

    endpoint Z

    • NE name Z end

    • Shelf Z end

    • Slot Z end

    • Port Z end

    • ChannelizedEndPointInfo Z-End (for OTN)

      • tribPort

      • payloadType

      • layerRate

      • tribSlot

    protection type

    • value

    • string ['SNCP']

    protection starts at

    • value

    • string ['AT_ENDPOINT', 'AT_FIRST_OPPORTUNITY', 'ON_CENTRAL_FABRIC']

    work path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)

    protect path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)

    movement package

    • primaryOperation (For example, Add_Protection)

    • primaryOperationType (For example, Preserve_Route)

    • originalServiceId (Original unprotected service TOP LEVEL FRE id)

Add Protection On L1 Control Plane Unprotected Transport Client Service

Below API describes about add protection on an L1 Control Plane unprotected service. In this API 'preserve route' option is being used for adding the protection on an unprotected service. Preserve route option preserves the existing unprotected service route as work leg and allow user to add new constraints for protect leg.

Prerequisites

  • User should have L1 Control Plane unprotected transport client service Provisioned/Discovered before performing 'Add protection' operation from Navigator MC GUI. Below screen-shot displays 'Add protection' button on Navigator MC GUI for L1 NCP unprotected service.

  • L1 Control Plane service should not have any special characters in its name. To add protection to an L1 CP service that has special characters in its name, the service name should be changed before performing the add protection operation and restored post its successful completion.

  • The L1 Control Plane service should be GEP enabled. This operation is not supported on NON GEP Control Plane services.

Steps

  1. Retrieve product id from Navigator MC Server for L1 Control Plane protected service

    Description: Different service types are mapped to different products in Navigator MC. This step is to retrieve the product id for a service (Control Plane protected) which user wants to create. In this case, it is L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/products

    Sample response:

  {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "5c1ae007-d0fb-4fa2-8805-c6365795ae6b",
        "resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade",
        "title": "product for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade",
        "active": true,
        "domainId": "built-in",
        "constraints": {},
        "providerData": {
          "template": "ifd.v6.serviceTemplates.L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade"
        }
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "offset": 0,
    "limit": 1000
  }

  1. Create facade for L1 Control plane Protected service

    Description: The facade encapsulates all request parameters provided by user. Whenever an external client connects to Navigator MC Server, it needs to send in all request parameter in facade used for that service. In this case, it is L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

    Request Parameters:

    Parameter Value

    product ID

    Retrieved from step 2

    Label and name

    <name of the SNC>

    interactive_mode

    True/False

    Layer rate

    <layer rate>

    Ex: DSR_10GE, OC192, ODU0, ODU2 etc

    directionality

    Bidirectional

    diversityType

    LINK_DIVERSE/BUNDLE_DIVERSE,

    endpoint A

    ? NE name A end

    • Shelf id A end

    • Slot A end

    • Port A end

    • protectionType

    Ex: SNCP, APS

    • protectionStartsAt

    Ex: ON_A_DEVICE_WITH_CENTRAL_FABRIC, AT_THE_ENDPOINT

    • ODU Payload A end (for OTN channelized)

    endpoint Z

    • NE name Z end

    • Shelf id Z end

    • Slot Z end

    • Port Z end

    • protectionType

      Ex: SNCP, APS

    • protectionStartsAt

      Ex: ON_A_DEVICE_WITH_CENTRAL_FABRIC, AT_THE_ENDPOINT

    • ODU Payload Z end (for OTN channelized)

    workSncAttributes

    <Refer to table below>

    protectSncAttributes

    <Refer to table below>

    sncAttributes parameters:

    Parameter Value

    primaryPathConstraints

    Constraints for Home Path

    restorationPathConstraints

    Constraints for Restoration Path (only for MR-SNC)

    controlPlanePackage

    Control Plane parameters. See Table below.

    controlPlanePackage parameters:

    Parameter Value

    rhp (Attribute for Retain Home Path)

    True/False

    resiliencyType

    PERMANENT/MESH_RESTORABLE

    homePathPreemption

    Home Path Preemption parameters (Optional if not using Preemption NORMAL_PRIORITY_NON_PREEMPTABLE, NORMAL_PRIORITY_PREEMPTABLE, EXTRA_TRAFFIC)

    restorationPathPreemption

    Restoration Path Preemption parameters (Optional if not using Preemption DISABLED, HIGH_PRIORITY_NON_PREEMPTABLE, MEDIUM_PRIORITY_NON_PREEMPTABLE, MEDIUM_PRIORITY_PREEMPTABLE, NORMAL_PRIORITY_NON_PREEMPTABLE, NORMAL_PRIORITY_PREEMPTABLE, EXTRA_TRAFFIC)

    movementPackage parameters:

    Parameter Value

    primaryOperation

    Add_Protection

    primaryOperationType

    (For example, Preserve_Route)

    originalServiceId

    Original unprotected service TOP LEVEL FRE id
homePathPreemption and restorationPathPreemption are only applicable when GCS property is set for Preemption.

GCS request for Preemption POST - https://127.0.0.1/gcs/api/v1/config

Sample Request Body

  [
    {
      "title": "sncPreemption",
      "name": "sncPreemption",
      "application": "bpo-ifd",
      "value": "True",
      "instance": "-"

  1. Get the requested route

    Description: Get the requested route using the request route id obtained in step 7.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{SW_MRSNC_IFD_INTENT_RESOURCE_ID}/operations /{OP_ID}

    Request parameters:

    • SW_MRSNC_IFD_INTENT_RESOURCE ID: the resource ID from step 6.

    • OPID: the request route ID from Step 7.

    The state of the operation should be ?successful?. If the state is still ?executing?, wait and try the same command.

    "id": "5c1af248-0513-4225-a563-9fa889c80d4e",

    "inputs": {},
    "outputs": {

      ],
      "serviceTrails": [
        {...},

      ]
    },
    "state": "successful",
    "reason": "",
    "progress": [],

    "updatedAt": "2018-12-20T01:38:15.279Z",
    "resourceStateConstraints": {},
    "executionGroup": "lifecycle"
  }
The number of distinct sets of routes returned by this API is configurable and can be set in Navigator MC server using the property ifd.l0.numberOfPceRoutesReturned in file default_config.json.
The first route returned by PCE in the list (at index 0) is the best route calculated using the given constraints.
In case of Mesh Restorable service, the number of restoration routes can be set using the property ifd.l1.maxRestorationPaths in default_config.json.
For MR-SNC, due to a 6500 NE limitation the maximum number of restoration paths returned will be four. As a result, there will be one home path and at most four restoration paths for each leg.

Remove Protection On L1 Control Plane Protected Transport Client Service

Below API describes about the remove protection of a L1 Control Plane protected service.

Prerequisites

  • User should have L1 Control Plane Protected transport client service before performing 'Convert to unprotected' operation on Navigator MC GUI.

  • L1 Control Plane service should not have any special characters in its name. To remove protection from an L1 CP service that has special characters in its name, the service name should be changed before performing the remove protection operation and restored post its successful completion.

  • The L1 Control Plane service should be GEP enabled. This operation is not supported on NON GEP Control Plane services.

Steps

  1. Get managed service container intent

    Description: Get resource of type ManagedServicesContainer

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?exactTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer

    Sample response:

  {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "6050314d-eb20-4cce-b24f-a4d873e3689a",
        "label": "Resource for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer",

Prerequisites

L1 Control Plane Service Resize Operation

Use this procedure to perform Resize operations on Transport Client (SNC, SNCP and OPS services).

  • Resize

  • Resize with Auto-move

Requirements

  • Local and remote network elements must be synchronized successfully in Navigator MC.

  • The service must be provisioned on the network element using Node Manager or Navigator MC.

  • The deployment state of the service must be Discovered or Deployed for the operation.

  • The service must be an ODUFlex connection with Resizable as True.

  • Allow regroom attribute must be True for Auto-move functionality.

  • The service should be On home for the operation.

Steps

  1. Resize of L1 Control Plane Service

    Description: Resize of L1 Control Plane Service. In request body freId (ID of the Transport Client service), bitRate and autoMove is to be provided.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{ManagedServicesContainer_ID}/operations

Sample Post Body

  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Resize",
        "freId": "2437223371115155611",
        "bitRate": "9993417841",
        "autoMove": true
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }

  • Resize with Auto-move is not applicable for ODUFlex rate less than the current rate.

  • If both legs of the SNCP are active, Navigator MC will not allow resize.

  • For OPS service if first SNC fails, Navigator MC will not proceed to resize the second SNC.

  • For resize with same existing ODUFlex rate, Navigator MC will succeed without sending command to NE.

L1 Non Control Plane Transport Client Service Resize Operation

Use this procedure to perform Resize operations on L1 Non Control Plane Transport Client (Unprotected, SNCP and OPS services).

Requirements

  • Local and remote network elements must be synchronized successfully in Navigator MC.

  • The service must be provisioned on the network element using Node Manager or Navigator MC.

  • The deployment state of the service must be Discovered or Deployed for the operation.

  • The service must be an ODUFlex connection with Resizable as True.

Steps

  1. Resize of L1 Non Control Plane Transport Client Service

    Description: Resize of L1 Non Control Plane Transport Client Service. In request body freId (ID of the Transport Client service), bitRate and lineRate, tribSlots and managedOperation are to be provided.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{ManagedServicesContainer_ID}/operations

Sample Post Body

  {
    "interface": "manageService",
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Resize",
        "freId": "-3114134410899116390",
        "tribSlots": "9",
        "bitRate": "11.29",
        "lineRate": "ODUFLEX"
      }
    }
  }

  1. Verfiy Resize Operation

Provision Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service

Users can use the Navigator MC API to provision an unprotected broadband asymmetric client service for the below-supported rates:

  • 100GbE to ODU4

  • ODU4 to 100GbE

  • 10GbE to ODU2e

  • ODU2e to 10GbE

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the following TOSCA definitions:

    • L1NCPServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1NCPServiceIntentFacadeBase.tosca

    • L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacadeTemplate.tosca

Steps

  1. Authorize and connect to the Navigator MC server.

    Description: This command will connect to Navigator MC and generate a bearer token to be used for consecutive commands. The value of the token retrieved above will go in the header of all subsequent requests against the key “Authorization”.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/tron/api/v2/tokens

    Request Parameters in Body:

    Key Value

    grant_type

    password

    username

    <user name of Navigator MC user>

    password

    <password of Navigator MC user>

    Sample response:

  {
    "failedLoginAttempts": 0,
    "lastSuccessIpAddress": "172.16.0.1",
    "lastSuccessLogin": "2021-08-26 00:04:12.510380+00:00",
    "postLoginMessage": null,
    "token": "617a0a01856266dace24",
    "user": "e1580b25-d105-442e-b97d-74e8d625dc11",

    "radiusState": ""
  }

  1. Retrieve product id from Navigator MC Server.

    Description: Different service types are mapped to different products in Navigator MC. This step is to retrieve the product id of the type of the service (NCP asymmetric SNC) the user wants to create. In this case, it is L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/products?includeInactive=false&q=resourceTypeId%3Aifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade&limit=1000

    Sample response:

     {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "5f1170ea-fab1-4f1b-a8a8-66f01ae06619",
        "resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade",
        "title": "product for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade",
        "active": true,
        "domainId": "built-in",
        "constraints": {},
        "providerData": {
          "template": "ifd.v6.serviceTemplates.L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade"
        }
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "offset": 0,
    "limit": 1000
  }

  1. Create facade for Broadband unprotected asymmetric client service.

    Description: The facade encapsulates all request parameters provided by the user. Whenever an external client connects to Navigator MC Server, it needs to send in all request parameters in the facade used for that service. In this case, it is L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

    Request Parameters:

    Parameter Value

    product ID

    Retrieved from step 2

    Label or name

    <name of the SNC>

    interactive_mode

    True/False

    Layer rate

    <layer rate>

    Ex: DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE etc

    endpoint A

    • <Network Element> name A-End

    • Shelf A end

    • Slot A end

    • Port A end

    • layerRate (DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE etc)

    endpoint Z

    • <Network Element> name Z-End

    • Shelf Z end

    • Slot Z end

    • Port Z end

    • layerRate (ODU2e, ODU4 etc)

    primary path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)
The user has to provide layer rate in both endpoints while activating the facade in case of broadband unprotected asymmetric client service provisioning. Sample request is shown in below snapshot

  1. Retrieve the relationship between Facade and Service Intent.

    Description: Every facade from a client service is mapped to a Service Intent on the Navigator MC server. This call will provide the target id which is the service Intent ID of the desired service and will be used in the subsequent calls to the Navigator MC server.

    The response will contain multiple entries. The user needs to filter out the one based on the sourceId which is the facade id created in step 3.

    {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/relationships

    Sample response:

  1. Commit route requests for Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service.

    Description: Commit route stores tpe and fre expectations of Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service in NSI.

    POST - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RSC_ID}/operations

    POST - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/6126dabc-88fc-41dd-aeee-305c8da6ffd9/operations

Sample request:

{
  "interface": "commitRoute",
  "inputs": {
    "routes": [
      {{SELECTED_ROUTE}}
    ],
    "routes_equipment":[
    ]
  }
}

  1. Check the status of service intent.

    Description: This step checks the status of the service intent after submitting the provisioning request (commit route Step). If an asymmetric service has successfully provisioned on the node, the deployment state of the intent should be COMPLETE_FULLY_READY.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RSC_ID}

    Request parameter:

    • Service Intent Id

Sample response:

  {

Deprovision Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service

This section will describe the deprovisioning steps for a Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service. Following steps are required for deprovisioning a service:

  1. Get Managed Services Container.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?exactTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer

        "id": "6126d940-c9d1-4079-beb8-46a66067c072",

  1. Retrieve the relationship between Facade and Service Intent.

    Description: Every facade from a client is mapped to a Service Intent on the Navigator MC server. This call will provide the target id which is the service Intent ID of the desired service and will be used in the subsequent calls to the Navigator MC server.

  1. Delete Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service by FRE.

    Description: Delete Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service FRE.

  1. Verify Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service deletion using FACADE ID.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{FCD_RSC_ID}

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/6126daba-9d2c-4699-925e-274c21890b23

    Request parameter:

    • FCD_RSC_ID - Facade resource id will be received from step 2

Sample response:

  {
    "statusCode": 404,

      "reason": "Resource '6126daba-9d2c-4699-925e-274c21890b23' not found",
      "detail": ""

  1. Verify Broadband Unprotected Asymmetric Client Service deletion using Intent Resource ID.

    Description: All the FREs, TPEs and expectation should be deleted if user fetches through intent resource id.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/nsi/api/{NSI_VER}/fres?freExpectations.serviceIntent.id={INTENT_RSC_ID}&include=tpes, expectations, frePlanned, freDiscovered

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/nsi/api/v6/fres?freExpectations.serviceIntent.id=6126dabc-88fc-41dd-aeee-305c8da6ffd9&include=tpes, expectations, frePlanned, freDiscovered

  {

Provision of L1 TCM based APS Protected Transport Client Services

L1 TCM based APS protected transport client services are only applicable for NTK532GA/GN and NTK537BA cards.

Prerequisites

Before you begin:

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the following TOSCA definitions:

    • ServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacadeTemplate.tosca

Steps

  1. Authorize and connect to the Navigator MC server.

    Description: This command will connect to Navigator MC and generate a bearer token to be used for consecutive commands. The value of the token retrieved above will go in the ‘header’ of all subsequent requests against the key ‘Authorization’.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/tron/api/v2/tokens

    Request Parameters in Body:

    Key Value

    grant_type

    password

    username

    <user name of Navigator MC user>

    password

    <password of Navigator MC user>

    Sample response:

  {
    "failedLoginAttempts": 0,
    "lastSuccessIpAddress": "172.16.0.1",
    "lastSuccessLogin": "2021-11-28 22:03:00.185071+00:00",
    "postLoginMessage": null,
    "token": "b148110a8286c5ad6e57",
    "user": "bbc2c60b-4b7b-4d54-b3b5-666e125a70b7",
    "loginDetail": {
      "ipAddress": "172.16.0.1",
      "sessionId": "cdea78ff-cee8-45cb-a51f-ce6feae2ef71",
      "sessionType": "Machine",
      "time": "2021-11-28T22:03:00.904111Z",
      "userAgent": "PostmanRuntime/7.9.1"
    },
    "createdTime": "2021-11-28T22:03:00.904111Z",
    "inactiveExpirationTime": null,
    "isSuccessful": true,
    "timeout": 2592000,
    "userTenantUuid": "bc7b5009-5ccc-409b-b173-1116b3596337",
    "radiusState": ""
  }

  1. Retrieve product id from Navigator MC Server

    Description: Different service types are mapped to different products in Navigator MC. This step is to retrieve the product id of the type of this L1 TCM based APS 1+1 protected service. In this case, it is L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/products?includeInactive=false&q=resourceTypeId%3Aifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade&limit=1000

    Sample response:

  {
     "id": "633f8010-4fdf-11ec-a263-f9528e121634",
     "resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade",
     "title": "product for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade",
     "active": true,
     "domainId": "built-in",
     "constraints": {},
     "providerData": {
       "template": "ifd.v6.serviceTemplates.L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade"
     }
   }

  1. Create facade for L1 TCM based APS 1+1 protected service

    Description: The facade encapsulates all request parameters provided by the user. Whenever an external client connects to Navigator MC Server, it needs to send in all request parameters in the facade used for that service. In this case, it is L1NCPProtClientServiceIntentFacade.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

    Request Parameters:

    Parameter Value

    product ID

    Retrieved from step 2

    Label or name

    <name of the L1 TCM based APS 1+1 protected Service>

    interactive_mode

    True/False

    Layer rate

    <layer rate>

    Ex: DSR_10GE, OC192, ODU2 etc

    endpoint A

    • <Network Element> name A end

    • Shelf A end

    • Slot A end

    • Port A end

    • ChannelizedEndPointInfo A-End (for OTN)

      • tribPort

      • payloadType

      • layerRate

      • tribSlot

    endpoint Z

    • NE name Z end

    • Shelf Z end

    • Slot Z end

    • Port Z end

    • ChannelizedEndPointInfo Z-End (for OTN)

      • tribPort

      • payloadType

      • layerRate

      • tribSlot

    apsProtectionUnitController

    • tcmLevel <integar value>

    • switchingDirectionality <unidirectional, bidirectional>

    sourceProtectionUnitController

    • autoReversionPossible <boolean value>

    • timerDetectionGuard

    • timerRecoveryGuard

    destinationProtectionUnitController

    • autoReversionPossible <boolean value>

    • timerDetectionGuard

    • timerRecoveryGuard

    protection type

    • value

    • string ['APS']

    protection starts at

    • value

    • string ['AT_ENDPOINT', 'AT_FIRST_OPPORTUNITY']

    work path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)

    protect path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)
    The values of attribute protectionType is APS.

  1. Commit route for L1 TCM based APS 1+1 protected service.

POST - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/6c05c250-4fe3-11ec-a263-f9528e121634/operations

L1 Control Plane provisioning of service with Resiliency Controller

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected and Unprotected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

  • Post Authorization and Market resource retrieval, create facade with the sncAttributes/work,protect sncAttributes having sncResiliencyController block in it with L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade or L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

Sample Unprotected Facade sncAttributes

  "sncAttributes": {
      "numberOfRestorationPaths": 8,
      "restorationPathConstraints": {
          "pathConstraint": {
              "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
          }
      },
      "controlPlanePackage": {
          "dtlSetExclusivity": "Working",
          "rhp": false,
          "regroomAllowed": true,
          "resiliencyType": "MESH_RESTORABLE",
          "protectionClass": "Unprotected High"
      },
      "primaryPathConstraints": {
          "pathConstraint": {
              "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
          }
      },
      "sncResiliencyController": {
          "todrTime": "02:00",
          "todrTimePeriod": 60,
          "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
          "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
          "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
          "autoReversionType": "timeOfDay"
      }
  }

  • For non-revertive connections user should not provide sncResiliencyController block in the facade.

L1 Control Plane Service Pinching

Use this procedure to enable node pinching feature while provisioning of Closed-Closed MR-SNCP service.

  • GCS parameter pinchPoint to be enabled as true.

    POST {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/gcs/api/v1/config

    Sample Request

      [
    {
      "application": "bpo-ifd",
      "instance": "-",
      "name": "pinchPoint",
      "title": "pinchPoint",
      "value": "true",
      "key": "bpo-ifd/-/pinchPoint"
    }
  ]

  • pinchPoint attribute to be set as true under controlPlanePackage package while provisioning MR-SNCP.

Requirements

  • Originating network element must be 6500 T-Series device with release >=15.0.

  • Local and remote network elements must be synchronized successfully in Navigator MC.

  • pinchPoint is mutually exclusive with ARD.

  • Both SNCP legs should have the same pinchPoint.

  • All switching operations are blocked if the MR-SNCP is in a pinched state.

L1 Control Plane Limited Mesh feature

Use this procedure to enable the limited mesh feature on SNC/SNCP.

POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

Sample Request

  "sncAttributes": {
         "controlPlanePackage": {
             "resiliencyType" : "MESH_RESTORABLE",
             "meshAttemptLimitEnabled" : true,
             "meshAttemptLimit" : 3,
             "dtlSetExclusivity" : "Working",
             "rhp" : false,
             "regroomAllowed" : true,
             "protectionClass" : "Unprotected High"
         }
     }

  • Under the controlPlanePackage package, while provisioning MR-SNC or MR-SNCP, the meshAttemptLimitEnabled attribute needs to be set as true with meshAttemptLimit, ranging from 1 to 10 (Default value: 3).

Requirements

  • Originating network element must be 54xx or 6500 T-Series device with release >=15.0.

  • Local and remote network elements must be synchronized successfully in Navigator MC.

  • For 6500 MR SNCP, the “Limited Mesh” feature can be set on the work SNC only. The exact value is then set to protect leg by default.

  • For the 6500 protected tail, the “Limited Mesh” feature is only supported when protection is SNCP and the protection type is “On a device with central fabric”.

  • For 54xx, you can set this attribute value separately on the Working and the Protection Path.

L1 Control Plane Protection Class

protectionClass attribute to be set as Unprotected Low or Unprotected High under controlPlanePackage package while provisioning of control plane service.

Sample Unprotected Facade sncAttributes

  [
    "sncAttributes": {
              "controlPlanePackage": {
                  "dtlSetExclusivity": "Working",
                  "rhp": false,
                  "regroomAllowed": true,
                  "resiliencyType": "PERMANENT",
                  "protectionClass": "Unprotected High"
              },
              "primaryPathConstraints": {
                  "pathConstraint": {
                      "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
                  }
              },
              "sncResiliencyController": {
                  "todrTime": "02:00",
                  "todrTimePeriod": 60,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
                  "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
                  "autoReversionType": "none"
              }
          }

  ]

protectionClass is mapped to recoveryPriority in resiliencyController.

Sample Response for resiliencyController

  [
      {
        "id": "6069fd16-f409-3931-8577-cddfd0a12391::DEMO-Auto-NE-OSRP11::TC17 PSNC High-W::resiliencyController",
        "type": "resiliencyController",
        "attributes": {
          "recoveryCharacteristics": {
            "onHome": true,
            "homeAvailable": true,
            "recoveryPriority": "high",
            "displayLabels": {
              "todrProfileList": "Todr profile list",
              "switchTimeUnit": "Switch time unit",
              "holdbackThreshold": "Holdback threshold",
              "onHome": "On home",
              "timerRecoveryGuardTimeUnit": "Timer recovery guard time unit",
          }
          }
        }
      }
  ]

  • 'Unprotected Low' is not supported for 5400 S-SNCP

L1 Control Plane provisioning of Service with Exclusion Profile

Overview

  • This functionality allows users to provision L1 Control Plane services both protected and un-protected with Exclusion Profile.

  • Exclusion Profile specifies the links that Control Plane excludes while route calculation.

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected and Unprotected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

Procedure

  • Post Authorization and Market resource retrieval, create facade with the attributes having exclusionProfile block in it with L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade or L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

Sample Unprotected Pure Control Plane Facade Attributes

  "sncAttributes": {
      "controlPlanePackage": {
          "dtlSetExclusivity": "Preferred",
          "rhp": false,
          "regroomAllowed": true,
          "resiliencyType": "PERMANENT",
          "protectionClass": "Unprotected High"
      },
      "primaryPathConstraints": {
          "pathConstraint": {
              "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
          }
      },
      "sncResiliencyController": {
          "todrTime": "02:00",
          "todrTimePeriod": 60,
          "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
          "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
          "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
          "autoReversionType": "none"
      },
      "exclusionProfile": {
          "profileId": "OSRP-12-1::EXCLTL-12-1"
      }
  }

Sample Unprotected Tail Facade Attributes

  "sncAttributes": {
      "controlPlanePackage": {
          "dtlSetExclusivity": "Preferred",
          "rhp": false,
          "regroomAllowed": true,
          "resiliencyType": "PERMANENT",
          "protectionClass": "Unprotected High"
      },
      "primaryPathConstraints": {
          "pathConstraint": {
              "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
          }
      },
      "sncResiliencyController": {
          "todrTime": "02:00",
          "todrTimePeriod": 60,
          "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
          "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
          "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
          "autoReversionType": "none"
      },
      "exclusionProfile": {
          "originatingNE": "80650b19-28c1-3ff4-85be-2b3623d4857d",
          "profileId": "OSRP-12-1::EXCLTL-12-1"
      }
  }

  • Exclusion Profile is not used in Navigator MC route calculation.

  • If exclusionProfile block is specified, profileId is a mandatory attribute for all types of connections and originatingNE is mandatory while creating a Tail connection.

  • originatingNE is the physical NC Id of the core originating Node.

  • exclusionProfile is only applicable with exclusivity PREFERRED or WORKING except for Permanent connection where only PREFERRED is applicable.

  • DTLs take precedence over the Exclusion Profile.

L1 Control Plane provisioning of 10GbE GFP Mapped Client Service

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected and Unprotected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

  • Post Authorization and Market resource retrieval, create facade with the endpoints having mapping attribute in it with L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade or L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

Sample Unprotected Facade endPoints

  "endPointA": [
    {
      "networkElement": {
        "name": "G7130-NodeC-003"
      },
      "ains": "ACTIVE",

      "port": "1",
      "shelf": "3",
      "slot": "11",
      "layerRate": "DSR_10GE",
      "mapping": "GFP-E"
    }
  ],
  "endPointZ": [
    {
      "networkElement": {
        "name": "G7130-NodeF-006"
      },
      "ains": "ACTIVE",
      "signalConditioning": "NONE",
      "port": "2",
      "shelf": "6",
      "slot": "3",
      "layerRate": "DSR_10GE",
      "mapping": "GFP-E"
    }
  ]

  • Mapping values could be [PROP237, GFP-F, GFP-E or GFP-P] as per the NE Type and the the port provided.

  • Mapping is supported for both symmetric and asymmetric connections for the rate 10GE.

  • Reconfiguration from PROP237 to GFP or vice versa with service endpoint on 54xx device is not supported via Navigator MC/REST while provisioning.

Provision Broadband Unprotected 10GbE GFP Mapped Client Service

Users can use the Navigator MC API to provision an unprotected broadband 10GbE client service with GFP mappings on the below-supported cards:

  • WL3n MOTR

  • 4x10G OTR

  • NTK532Gx

  • NTK537xA

  • 100GMUX

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the following TOSCA definitions:

    • L1NCPServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1NCPServiceIntentFacadeBase.tosca

    • L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacadeTemplate.tosca

Steps

  1. Authorize and connect to the Navigator MC server.

    Description: This command will connect to Navigator MC and generate a bearer token to be used for consecutive commands. The value of the token retrieved above will go in the header of all subsequent requests against the key “Authorization”.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/tron/api/v2/tokens

    Request Parameters in Body:

    Key Value

    grant_type

    password

    username

    <user name of Navigator MC user>

    password

    <password of Navigator MC user>

    Sample response:

    Description: Different service types are mapped to different products in Navigator MC. This step is to retrieve the product id of the type of the service the user wants to create. In this case, it is L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/products?includeInactive=false&q=resourceTypeId%3Aifd.v6.resourceTypes.L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade&limit=1000

  1. Create facade for Broadband unprotected client service.

    Description: The facade encapsulates all request parameters provided by the user. Whenever an external client connects to Navigator MC Server, it needs to send in all request parameters in the facade used for that service. In this case, it is L1NCPClientServiceIntentFacade.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources

    Request Parameters:

    Parameter Value

    product ID

    Retrieved from step 2

    Label or name

    <name of the SNC>

    interactive_mode

    True/False

    Layer rate

    <layer rate>

    Ex: DSR_10GE, DSR_100GE etc

    mapping

    <mapping>

    Ex: PROP237, GFP-F, GFP-E, GFP-P

    endpoint A

    • <Network Element> name A-End

    • Shelf A end

    • Slot A end

    • Port A end

    • mapping (GFP-E)

    endpoint Z

    • <Network Element> name Z-End

    • Shelf Z end

    • Slot Z end

    • Port Z end

    • mapping (GFP-E)

    primary path constraint

    • value

    • objectType (OTU_LINKS_NAME)

    • constraintType (HARD)

Validate scheduled service before activation

If a scheduled service has to be activated, pre deploy validation can ensure that:

  • No equipment in the service path is missing.

  • No equipment in the service path is having a part mismatch.

  • No equipment in the service path is in maintenance mode.

  • All nodes in the service path are in GOA.

  • Spectrum along the service path is currently available.

  • No node in the service path is in maintenance.

The below API describes validating a scheduled service before activating it.

Steps

  1. Get managed service container intent

    Description: Get resource of type ManagedServicesContainer

Resolve Deployment state Operation

Deployment failed service deployment state can be corrected in following cases:

  • If the failed service provisioning is corrected in the network such that the service is up in the network, then the "Resolve deployment state" will update the Deployment State from "Deployment Failed" to "Deployed".

  • If the failed service provisioning is completely removed from the network (manually by the user), then the "Resolve deployment state" will update the Deployment state from "Deployment failed" to "Scheduled" using a default activation date 9999-12-31.

  • If there are network entities associated with the failed service provisioning, the Deployment state will not be updated by "Resolve deployment state". The Service history will display the reason for the service’s inability to transition.

The below API describes resolve deployment state of a deployment failed service.

Steps

  1. Get managed service container intent

    Description: Get resource of type ManagedServicesContainer

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?exactTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer

    Sample response:

  {
    "items": [
      {
  			"id": "600be8c0-9403-11ee-9f16-f94c1690c502",
  			"label": "Resource for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer",
  			"resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer",
  			"productId": "5339982c-9403-11ee-9f16-ad0bfbc234cf",
  			"domainId": "built-in",
  			"tenantId": "6e89ad36-0405-4d2c-87a1-1827f34539d7",
  			"shared": false,
  			"subDomainId": "7fd5144c-552f-39a3-9464-08d3b9cfb251",
  			"properties": {},
  			"discovered": false,
  			"differences": [],
  			"desiredOrchState": "active",
  			"orchState": "active",
  			"reason": "",
  			"tags": {},
  			"providerData": {},
  			"updatedAt": "2023-12-06T06:47:51.819Z",

Managed service container id (MSC_ID) will be received from the above response.

  1. Resolve Deployment State of a deployment failed service

L1 Control Plane Service Edit Routing Constraints

Use this procedure to edit routing constraints of a pre-provisioned pure L1 controlplane service (excluding Tails) both protected and unprotected.

  1. Get managed service intent

    Description: Get resource of type ManagedServicesContainer

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources?exactTypeId=ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer

    Sample response:

  {
        "id": "5f193d38-d5b6-4c7c-ab63-7ae18d6a5d5b",
        "label": "Resource for ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer",
        "resourceTypeId": "ifd.v6.resourceTypes.ManagedServicesContainer",
        "productId": "5f193d2a-a758-4722-ace9-59adf930a0b6",
        "tenantId": "c01536b5-50dc-4697-97d2-d13293756293",
        "shared": false,
        "subDomainId": "7fd5144c-552f-39a3-9464-08d3b9cfb251",
        "properties": {},
        "discovered": false,
        "differences": [],
        "desiredOrchState": "active",
        "orchState": "active",
        "reason": "",
        "tags": {},
        "providerData": {
          "templateResources": {}
        },
        "updatedAt": "2022-08-22T07:33:12.701Z",
        "createdAt": "2022-08-22T07:33:12.591Z",
        "revision": 13194139535809,
        "autoClean": false,
        "updateState": "unset",
        "updateReason": "",
        "updateCount": 0
      }
Managed service container id (MSC_ID) will be received from the above response.

  1. Edit L1 ControlPlane service

    Description: Edit L1 ControlPlane service by FRE ID

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{msc_id}/operations

    Request parameter:

    • MSC_ID - Managed service container id - Received from above step.

    • TOP_LEVEL_FRE - Top level fre of L1 CP service.

    • serviceEditAttributes - All the routing constraints including the changed ones.

Sample request:

  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Edit_Service",
        "freId": "{TOP_LEVEL_FRE}",
        "serviceEditAttributes": {
          "interactive_mode": "true",
          "routingType": "MCP_DEFINED",
          "sncAttributes": {
            "controlPlanePackage": {
              "dtlSetExclusivity": "Working",
              "rhp": false,
              "regroomAllowed": true,
              "resiliencyType": "PERMANENT",
              "protectionClass": "Unprotected Low"
            },
            "primaryPathConstraints": {
              "excludeRouteObjects": [
                {
                  "locations": [
                    {
                      "nodeName": "hc35-Vm178"
                    }
                  ],
                  "objectType": "NODE_NAME",
                  "constraintType": "HARD"
                }
              ],
              "pathConstraint": {
                "pathConstraintOption": "MIN_HOP"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }
The above step would return the facade Id of a deployed service and for discovered service, promote it and return the Facade Id.

  1. Retrieve the relationship between Façade and Service Intent.

    Description: Every facade from a client is mapped to a Service Intent on the Navigator MC server. This call will provide the target id which is the service Intent ID of the desired service and will be used in the subsequent calls to the Navigator MC server.

    The response will contain multiple entries. The user needs to filter out the one based on the sourceId which is the facade id fetched in step 2.

    {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/relationships

    Sample response:

  {
        "id": "5c1af234-0f76-47a0-b12a-c6f4eeda665e",
        "relationshipTypeId": "ifd.v6.relationshipTypes.FcHasFacade",
        "properties": {},
        "sourceId": "5c1af232-8260-4fb1-b12d-da338694bccb",
        "requirementName": "facades",
        "targetId": "5c1af233-9ce9-45ee-b49a-d762bd6b9b7b",
        "capabilityName": "l1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacadeCapability",
        "orchState": "active",
        "reason": "",
        "providerData": {}
      }

  1. Retrieve Service Intent from Navigator MC server

    Description: This call retrieves the service intent from the server using the intent id retrieved above.

    GET{BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RESOURCE_ID}

    Request parameters: Service Intent Id retrieved from step 3

  1. Request Route for the service

    Description: This call is to request the server for routes between the specified end points. The output of call is the Request route ID which must be used to query for the routes in the next step.

    POST{BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RESOURCE_ID}/operations

    Request parameters in URL:

    • INTENT_RESOURCE_ID - Service Intent Id

    Request parameters in body:

  {
    "interface": "requestRoutes"
  }

Sample response:

  {
    "id": "5c1af248-0513-4225-a563-9fa889c80d4e",
    "resourceId": "5c1af233-9ce9-45ee-b49a-d762bd6b9b7b",
    "interface": "requestRoutes",
    "inputs": {},
    "outputs": {},
    "state": "requested",
    "reason": "",
    "progress": [],
    "providerData": {},
    "createdAt": "2022-08-22T01:37:12.657Z",
    "updatedAt": "2022-08-22T01:37:12.657Z",
    "resourceStateConstraints": {},
    "executionGroup": "lifecycle"
  }

  1. Get the requested route

    Description: Get the requested route using the request route id obtained in above step.

    GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RESOURCE_ID}/operations /{OP_ID}

    Request parameters:

    • INTENT_RESOURCE ID: the resource ID from step 4.

    • OPID: the request route ID from step 5.

    The state of the operation should be “successful”. If the state is still “executing”, wait and try the same command.

  1. Commit Route

    Description: In this step, the user commits one of the routes returned by Navigator MC in step 8.

    Request: POST - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/\6INTENT_RESOURCE_ID\}/operations

    Request parameter in request:

    • Service Intent Id

    Request parameters in body:

  {
      "interface": "commitRoute",
      "inputs":
    {
         "routes":
         [
              {{SELECTED_ROUTE}}
         ]
      }
  }

Here, INTENT_RESOURCE_ID is the id of the service intent.

Sample response:

  {
    "id": "5c1af29f-61e4-43cc-9dd5-862dc611fa71",
    "resourceId": "5c1af233-9ce9-45ee-b49a-d762bd6b9b7b",
    "interface": "commitRoute",
    "inputs": {
      "routes": [
        {...}
      ]
    },
    "outputs": {},
    "state": "requested",
    "reason": "",
    "progress": [],
    "providerData": {},
    "createdAt": "2022-08-22T01:38:39.137Z",
    "updatedAt": "2022-08-22T01:38:39.137Z",
    "resourceStateConstraints": {},
    "executionGroup": "lifecycle"
  }

  1. Check the status of service intent

    Description: This step checks the status of service intent after committing the route. If the SNC is successfully provisioned on the node, the deployment state of the intent should be COMPLETE_FULLY_READY.

    GET - {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{INTENT_RESOURCE_ID}

    Request parameter:

    • Service Intent Id

Editable Attributes

  • Cost criteria and associated attributes (maxAdminWt or min and maxLatencyTime, selectionCriteria)

  • Diversity type and associated attributes including ARD - (Supported for protected services only, not related services)

  • OVPNs

  • Include/Exclude NEs and Links

  • Exclusivity options

  • DTLSET (Explicit Route case)

  • Protection class

  • Discovered service post Edit Request Route or Predict Route would remain in a Deployed state.

  • REST user to pass the whole constraints in edit package for route computation.

  • Connections with Transport Client in discovered or plannedAndDiscovered state are allowed for Edit.

  • DTLSET name to be edited as _DTLS_1 and toggle back to _DTLSET (if edited again), similarly for DTLs as _D_1 and _DTL.

  • From the rest interface, the value of No. of restoration paths get changed but from UI it’s a non-editable field.

  • Feature is only applicable for pure controlplane services, not for Tails.

L1 Control Plane Service Operations

Use this procedure to perform Control Plane operations on SNC and SNCP legs.

  • Revert

  • Regroom

  • Make Current To Home

  • Manual Restore

Requirements

  • Local and remote network elements must be synchronized successfully in Navigator MC.

  • The service must be provisioned on the network element using Node Manager or Navigator MC.

  • The deployment state of the service must be Discovered or Deployed for the operation.

Steps

  1. Operations on L1 Control Plane Service

    Description: Operations on L1 Control Plane Service. In request body freId (ID of the SNC or SNCP leg) is to be provided.

    POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{ManagedServicesContainer_ID}/operations

Sample Post Body

Revert
  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Manual_Revert",
        "freId": "d2013555-a643-4a7c-9149-5512cd4d5783"
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }
Regroom
  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Manual_Regroom",
        "freId": "d2013555-a643-4a7c-9149-5512cd4d5783"
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }
Make Current To Home
  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Make_Current_To_Home",
        "freId": "d2013555-a643-4a7c-9149-5512cd4d5783"
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }
Manual Restore
  {
    "inputs": {
      "service": {
        "managedOperation": "Manual_Switch",
        "freId": "d2013555-a643-4a7c-9149-5512cd4d5783"
      }
    },
    "interface": "manageService"
  }

  • The Revert operation applies for both Dynamic SNC and SNCP leg with Off-Home and Home available as True.

  • The Regroom operation applies for Permanent and Dynamic SNC only with conditions:

    • Service with Network Defined Routes.

    • Service with DTLSET with Exclusivity as Preferred.

  • The Make Current Path To Home Path operation applies for Dynamic SNC with Network Defined Routes when service is Off-Home.

  • For Regroom and Make Current Path To Home Path operation, the Allow regroom attribute must be True for the connection being operated on.

  • Manual Restore option is only available for dynamic and On-Home services.

L1 Control Plane provisioning of Closed-Open SNCP Handoff to Open-Closed Broadband SNCP

Use this procedure to Provision L1 Control Plane closed to open SNCP handoff to open to closed Broadband SNCP.

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

  • Post Authorization and Market resource retrieval, create facade with the connectionStructure, having attributes aEndTailProtectionStartsAt or zEndTailProtectionStartsAt as SNCP_AT_THE_ENDPOINT and coreProtectionStartsAt as MAXIMIZE_RESILIENCY with L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.

Sample Protected Facade connectionStructure

  "connectionStructure": {
    "aEndTailProtectionStartsAt": "SNCP_AT_THE_ENDPOINT",
    "coreProtectionStartsAt": "MAXIMIZE_RESILIENCY",
    "zEndTailProtectionStartsAt": "NO_TAIL"
  }

Sample Protected Facade puControllers

  "puControllers": {
    "coreControllers": {
      "protectionUnitController": {
        "autoReversionPossible": false,
        "timerGuard": "0-MSEC"
      }
    },
    "aEndTailControllers": {
      "protectionUnitController": {
        "autoReversionPossible": false,
        "timerGuard": "0-MSEC"
      }
    },
    "zEndTailControllers": {}

Provisioning of L1 control plane switched OTN services using Virtual Connection Points (VCPs)

Use this procedure to Provision L1 Control Plane services using Virtual Connection Points (VCPs). This feature also supports protection in Tail with closed-closed and open-closed configurations.

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade’s connectionStructure with applicable values

  "connectionStructure": {
    "aEndTailProtectionStartsAt": "SNCP_AT_THE_ENDPOINT"
    "coreProtectionStartsAt": "MINIMIZE_BANDWIDTH",
    "zEndTailProtectionStartsAt": "NO_TAIL"
  }

  • Possible TailProtectionStartsAt values:

"NO_TAIL"
"UNPROTECTED"
"SNCP_AT_THE_ENDPOINT"
"SNCP_AT_THE_FIRST_OPPORTUNITY"
"APS_AT_THE_ENDPOINT"
"APS_AT_THE_FIRST_OPPORTUNITY"

  • Possible CoreProtectionStartsAt values:

"CLOSED_OSRP_SNCP"
"OPEN_OSRP_SNCP"
"MINIMIZE_BANDWIDTH"
"MAXIMIZE_RESILIENCY"
User can provision pre MCP7.2 protected configurations with both old and new connection parameters.

Configurations with possible Connection structure values.

  • Blue represents the control plane segment.

  • The above configurations also can be extended on either side based on FO (SNCP_AT_THE_FIRST_OPPORTUNITY) option.

  • In Minimize bandwidth, Navigator MC would try to close tail protection if tail protection exists and use only one SNC, otherwise it will use two SNCs (Open-Open configuration).

  • In Maximize resiliency, Navigator MC would try to close protection if tail protection exists and open OSRP SNCP, otherwise it will use two SNCs (Open-Open configuration).

Connection Structure Combinations.

Sample Protected Facade puControllers

  {
    "puControllers": {
      "coreControllers": {
        "protectionUnitController": {
          "autoReversionPossible": true,
          "waitToRevertDelay": 600,
          "autoReversionType": "delay",
          "timerGuard": "30-MSEC"
        }
      },
      "aEndTailControllers": {
        "protectionUnitController": {
          "todrTime": "02:05",
          "autoReversionPossible": true,
          "todrTimePeriod": 65,
          "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
          "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
          "autoReversionType": "timeOfDay",
          "timerGuard": "10-MSEC"
        }
      },
      "zEndTailControllers": {
        "protectionUnitController": {
          "todrTime": "02:10",
          "autoReversionPossible": true,
          "todrTimePeriod": 70,
          "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
          "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
          "autoReversionType": "timeOfDay",
          "timerGuard": "20-MSEC"
        }
      }
    }
  }
autoReversionType for Protection Unit (PU) would only be applied to ASNCP side PU.

  • Fallback to open-open route works with Minimize Bandwidth and Maximize Resiliency depending on the network.

  • Fallback only works if open-open control plane SNCs' endpoints are on different network elements.

  • Minimize Bandwidth with explicit route, protection parameters are not required, hence no fallback.

  • Minimize Bandwidth with compute best route, protection parameters are taken from the user and used only in case of fallback.

End

Provisioning of L1 control plane switched OTN services with drop side protection at endpoints

Use this procedure to Provision L1 control plane switched OTN services(unprotected and protected) with drop side protection on one or both ends.

Prerequisites

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

  • You should be familiar with the Switching Protected TOSCA definitions:

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntent.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade.tosca

    • L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntent.tosca

    • ServiceIntentAttributes.tosca

Supported Configurations

  • Drop side protection on one or both ends of a P-SNC, NMR-SNC or MR_SNC service

  • Drop side protection on one or both ends of an S-SNCP, NMR-SNCP or MR_SNCP service

L1OTNSwitchingServiceIntentFacade’s endPointA/Z with applicable values

  "endPointA/Z": [
      {
          "ains": "ACTIVE",
          "shelf": "1",
          "networkElement": {
              "name": "G8340-Auto-NODEA-#01"
          },
          "port": "1",
          "layerRate": "STM64",
          "signalConditioning": "NONE",
          "slot": "2"
      },
      {
          "ains": "ACTIVE",
          "shelf": "1",
          "networkElement": {
              "name": "G8340-Auto-NODEA-#01"
          },
          "port": "2",
          "layerRate": "STM64",
          "signalConditioning": "NONE",
          "slot": "2"
      }
  ],
The 0th element of endpoint’s list will always be considered work port and the 1st element will be considered its drop side protection port.

Sample Facade with client puControllers for unprotected service

  {
      "puControllers": {
          "aEndpointController": {
              "protectionUnitController": {
                  "autoReversionPossible": true,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "autoReversionType": "delay",
                  "timerGuard": "500-MSEC"
              }
          },
          "zEndpointController": {
              "protectionUnitController": {
                  "autoReversionPossible": true,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "autoReversionType": "delay",
                  "timerGuard": "500-MSEC"
              }
          }
      }
  }

L1OTNSwitchingProtServiceIntentFacade’s endPointA/Z with applicable values

  "endPointA/Z": [
      {
          "protServiceEndpoint": {
              "ains": "ACTIVE",
              "shelf": "2",
              "networkElement": {
                 "name": "G8340-Auto-NODEB-#02"
              },
              "port": "1",
              "layerRate": "OC192",
              "signalConditioning": "NONE",
              "slot": "19"
          }
      },
      {
          "protServiceEndpoint": {
              "ains": "ACTIVE",
              "shelf": "2",
              "networkElement": {
                  "name": "G8340-Auto-NODEB-#02"
              },
              "port": "2",
              "layerRate": "OC192",
              "signalConditioning": "NONE",
              "slot": "19"
          }
      }
  ]
The 0th element of endpoint’s list will always be considered work port and the 1st element will be considered its drop side protection port.

Sample Facade with client puControllers for protected service

  {
      "puControllers": {
          "aEndpointController": {
              "protectionUnitController": {
                  "autoReversionPossible": true,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "autoReversionType": "delay",
                  "timerGuard": "500-MSEC"
              }
          },
          "coreControllers": {
              "protectionUnitController": {
                  "autoReversionPossible": true,
                  "timerGuard": "500-MSEC",
                  "todrTime": "02:00",
                  "todrTimePeriod": 60,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "todrHoldbackPeriod": "24:00",
                  "todrHoldbackEnabled": false,
                  "autoReversionType": "timeOfDay"
              }
          },
          "zEndpointController": {
              "protectionUnitController": {
                  "autoReversionPossible": true,
                  "waitToRevertDelay": 300,
                  "autoReversionType": "delay",
                  "timerGuard": "500-MSEC"
              }
          }
      }
  }

  • Drop side protection is supported for services with STM64 and OC192 layer rates on 6500 T-Series 15.2 and above Nodes.

  • Drop side protection endpoint’s (work and protect) shelves should be same.

  • PU can only be configured with Reversion Type Wait To Restore(WTR).

End
